verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch is MIT-licensed and self-hostable with 'full data ownership' (hoppscotch-docs-11, hoppscotch-docs-14), and it supports importing cURL/OpenAPI collections, implying some collection/environment portability, but the evidence pack never documents an explicit 'export' feature or open data format (JSON/YAML) for collections, environments, or history that a user could take with them when leaving. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a data export function and confirmation of an open, portable export format, plus independent confirmation that a full account/data export works end-to-end.
